events.name: Soorasamharam – Skanda Sashti festival
events.description: The highlight of the temple's yearly Skanda Sashti festival (Nov 9–17, 2026): the evening re-enactment of Lord Murugan (Sri Singaravelar) defeating the demon Soorapadman. It was staged on North Mada Street next to the temple from about 7 pm, and at least 5,000 people came to watch.
